links.outcome: AI vs human expert echo analysis association with 1-year mortality (AUC)
links.effect: Multivariable AI and human mortality prediction were comparable (AUC 0.67 vs 0.66, P=0.86); adding AI automated strain analysis, AI model was superior (AUC 0.73 vs 0.66, P=0.048). AI LVEF was 5.8% higher than human.
links.quote: Incorporating automated strain analysis resulted stronger association with mortality of the AI analysis compared to standard human analysis.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative evaluation of commercially available echocardiographic AI software (Us2.ai) vs human expert interpretation for prognostic mortality prediction.
